plainTranslation: Drive and desire flow in sync. You move at the same pace, want similar things, and rarely step on each other. Failure mode: so frictionless it can lack tension. Enjoy the ease; keep some edge.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Your drives cooperate and spur each other. You get things done together. Take on the ambitious thing as a team.
tension: One thing to watch for is becoming comfortable with the potential instead of using it. Because working together feels so easy, you may assume there will always be time to act on your ideas. It becomes easy to talk about what you could do instead of actually doing it. Plans never quite become action. You know you make a good team, but you do not always challenge yourselves to put that strength to work.
advice: The opportunity here is to be intentional. Give yourselves a goal that matters. Choose something you want to create, improve, or accomplish together, then take the first step. The teamwork is already in place. The more you channel it into real action, the more rewarding and productive this connection becomes.
summaryShort: Your drives cooperate and spur each other.
